integrity: All included computations are directly reproducible; the all-length structural assertions and the cutoff rely on separately stated algebraic proofs and the degree-eight certificate.
scientific_limitations: No general closed cycle-count formula for all truncation lengths or all finite chain rings; exact census is only for F_2[t]/(t^10); historical priority subject to further specialist inspection.
title: Dyadic cycle periods and the first sixteen-cycles in binary chain-ring structure graphs
